item: a catalogue document row may declare its identity, doc_type and translation_kind, so the language versions of one treaty are one identity
key_paths: src/law/declared.py; src/law/lane_sync.py; src/law/model.py; scripts/validate_legal_catalog.py; configs/legal_sources.yml; tests/test_law_declared_identity.py; tests/fixtures/law/synthetic/treaty/
summary: v0.6.0 row C slice S3 (C-L2). A treaty page states no number a parser can read, so each language version was its own local identity keyed on its URL. A documents row may now declare identity {scheme, value} (act-number, e.g. mtdsg:xviii-1, a quoted string), doc_type and translation_kind; lane_sync looks the row up by its own (jurisdiction, url) and records what it states, so six language URLs become one LawIdentity with six tracked documents (original, translations, reader switch, second pass stable). The value is the operator's statement, never derived from the URL; a declaration the model refuses makes the whole row undeclared and fails the validator (generated and curated rows); a row declaring nothing is recorded as before. Declarations are retractable from the catalogue: a deleted translation_kind reads unrecorded, a category is taken back by declaring unspecified; ensure_identity(doc_type=None) means no statement so the shared identity is not reset by a version that declares none. Proven on a SYNTHETIC treaty (six invented bodies in zxx-* tags, .test hosts, no socket): 47 tests, 25 of 25 mutants killed; an independent Opus read found six things (irreversible declarations, a TypeError out of record_document, unquoted YAML numbers merging two laws, curated rows unchecked, two wording points), all folded. NOT done: no live treaty URL, no UN Treaty Collection or WIPO Lex row, no new host or licence token, SECURITY.md and net-hosts.js untouched, live ingestion waits on the operator's verified URLs. Open operator items: six verified URLs of one UN treaty with the robots and licence look; wipolex.wipo.int is a curated source domain missing from the 260-host count because the enumeration regex misses flow-style rows (not touched, R420 fence; its own follow-on PR under R189); no UN or WIPO licence token; WIPO Lex is typed ip so a treaty hosted there is not counted by the C-L1 floor; equally authentic texts have no vocabulary slot.
